holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue reached INR 24,138 crore with net profit of INR 125 crore for the September 2026 quarter.
The board approved internal restructuring of the Going-out India business and an Adonmo-Mygate share swap valued at approximately INR 156 crore.
ICRA reported no deviation in the deployment of QIP proceeds for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Flipkart initiated testing of 'Eat-in by Minutes' in Bengaluru to compete directly in food delivery.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding weight is 4.34%, the largest in the fund. A 6.04% 3-month return provided an estimated +0.262% contribution, buffering drawdown in other tech and consumer positions.

watch.text: Monitor the competitive rollout of Flipkart's 'Eat-in by Minutes' food delivery service.
Track order intake and delivery timelines for the Temple Batch 01 hardware devices.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached INR 21,537 crore on revenue of INR 95,132 crore.
The bank initiated an internal probe into two senior executives regarding the alleged leak of confidential business secrets.
Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha will step down on December 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Represents 4.31% of the fund. A 3-month return of -7.12% detracted -0.307% from performance, acting as the third-largest drag in the portfolio's core 32% Financials exposure.

watch.text: Watch regulatory actions and final findings from the executive information leak investigation.
Monitor leadership transition as the Deputy Managing Director steps down on December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported September 2026 quarter consolidated net profit of INR 16,333 crore and standalone net profit of INR 14,843 crore.
The CASA ratio declined 340 bps to 36.1% alongside an increase in FCNR (B) deposits.
The bank announced revisions to select savings account cash transaction charges effective December 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 4.12% fund weight, the stock slipped -2.52% over 3 months, creating a moderate headwind within the 32% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Observe deposit cost trends and CASA trajectory following the 340 bps ratio compression.
Assess customer adoption and fee impacts from the revised savings account service charges from December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd

what_changed.text: Incorporated step-down subsidiary Indian Ocean Gateway Terminal in Oman on October 21, 2026.
Incorporated Paradip Mahanadi Terminal as a wholly owned subsidiary to develop two dry bulk berths at Paradip Port.
Block deals worth INR 1,234 crore were executed in the market on October 9, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weight is 3.92% in the 21.2% Industrials basket. Its -1.6% 3-month return provided relative stability compared to broader market declines.

watch.text: Track Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results scheduled for board approval on October 28, 2026.
Monitor capital expenditure and operational progress at the newly formed Oman and Paradip terminals.

holdings.name: One 97 Communications Ltd

what_changed.text: NPCI deferred the implementation of MDR on select UPI P2M transactions until after Diwali.
Subsidiary First Gas Technologies received a GST demand notice of INR 703.66 crore for FY 2018-2023.
The company increased its shareholding in its subsidiary Little Internet.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carries a 3.68% fund weight. A 32.19% gain over 3 months made it the fund's top contributor, delivering +1.185% to total return.

watch.text: Track Q2 FY27 earnings disclosures on October 26, 2026 and the analyst call on October 27, 2026.
Monitor policy updates regarding UPI MDR merchant pricing post Diwali.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: RBI approved the appointment of Anup Kumar Saha as Managing Director & CEO for a three-year term beginning January 1, 2027.
Reported provisional Q2 FY27 net advances of INR 5,77,094 crore and deposits of INR 6,51,491 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: A 3.02% fund weight returning 14.0% over 3 months added +0.423% in estimated contribution, partially offsetting declines in HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance.

watch.text: Review audited Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings results at the board meeting on October 24, 2026.
Observe strategic alignment during the management transition leading to January 1, 2027.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported September 2026 quarter net profit of INR 6,367 crore with Gross NPA at 1.06% and Net NPA at 0.42%.
Issued 2,12,000 secured NCDs aggregating INR 2,120 crore maturing in October 2031.
Rising funding costs created downward pressure on net interest margins.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holds a 2.80% fund weight. A 3-month return of -9.4% created a -0.263% drag on portfolio performance.

watch.text: Observe net interest margin trajectory against elevated borrowing costs.
Track asset quality across unsecured loan segments after Gross NPA rose to 1.06%.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: Disclosed a suspected cybersecurity incident involving dark-web exposure of 3,897 customer records on October 16, 2026, while stating customer balances remain safe.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.78% fund weight, the stock fell -4.21% over 3 months, aligning with broader corrections in large-cap lenders.

watch.text: Track regulatory or forensic findings concerning the dark-web customer data leak.

holdings.name: Coforge Ltd

what_changed.text: Launched an intent engineering framework designed for governance-aligned enterprise AI agents.
Expanded the Kraków AI engineering facility, projecting local headcount to exceed 660 by 2027.
HDFC Mutual Fund reduced its stake in the company to 4.30%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighted at 2.72%, the stock jumped 32.56% over 3 months, contributing +0.886% as the fund's second-best performing holding.

watch.text: Check quarterly results and commentary during the earnings conference call on October 23, 2026.
Observe commercial monetization of newly introduced enterprise AI frameworks.

holdings.name: Adani Enterprises Ltd

what_changed.text: Signed an MoU with Jabil to set up a 50:50 joint venture for AI and data center hardware production in India.
CARE upgraded the long-term rating to AA Stable across INR 16,505 crore of bank facilities.

holdings.why_it_matters: Comprises 2.65% of the fund. A -15.28% 3-month drop contributed -0.405%, representing the portfolio's single largest performance detractor.

watch.text: Monitor unaudited Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results on October 28, 2026.
Track execution and binding agreements for the Jabil AI hardware joint venture.

portfolio.statement: Helios Flexi Cap Fund declined 5.07% over the past 3 months and 6.06% over the last month, driven by sharp drawdowns in key Financials and Adani Group holdings despite strong rallies in tech enablers.
interp: Top contributors One 97 Communications (+32.19%) and Coforge (+32.56%) provided +2.07% in combined estimated alpha, but could not offset widespread weakness across large-cap holdings.
The heavy 32% Financials allocation faced multiple headwinds, as declines in HDFC Bank (-7.12%) and Bajaj Finance (-9.4%) eroded capital despite Kotak Bank's +14% rally.
portfolio.line: Specialized fintech and mid-tier IT outpaced the broader market, while large-cap private credit, corporate governance concerns, and cyclical materials weighed on returns.

drivers.text: One 97 Communications gained 32.19% following the postponement of UPI MDR caps until after Diwali.
Coforge advanced 32.56% on aggressive expansion of its enterprise AI capabilities and Kraków center.
HDFC Bank dropped 7.12% amid an internal probe into sensitive data leaks by senior executives.
Bajaj Finance slipped 9.4% due to rising funding costs compressing lending margins.

themes.title: Digital Transformation & Fintech Rebound
themes.text: Significant outperformance was concentrated in digital finance and enterprise software enablers.

themes.title: Private Banking & Credit Margin Compression
themes.text: Key private financials struggled with rising cost of funds, deposit mix shifts, and leadership transitions.

macro.why: Rising domestic borrowing rates squeezed margins and heightened net interest margin sensitivity.
Digital payment policy delays and internal data security reviews impacted stock sentiment.

priced_in.text: Near-term deferral of UPI MDR monetization is largely absorbed following post-Diwali timelines.
NIM compression from higher funding costs has been reflected in Bajaj Finance's post-earnings pullback.

could_change.title: Resolution of HDFC Bank Executive Leak Probe
could_change.text: A swift conclusion to internal data breach findings could stabilize governance concerns and market valuation.

could_change.title: UPI MDR Fee Implementation Post Diwali
could_change.text: Any final regulatory structure on UPI merchant fees will reshape medium-term unit economics for payment aggregators.

portfolio.risk_note: A heavy 32% concentration in Financials exposes the portfolio to sector-wide margin pressure and operational risk disclosures across major lenders.
